detail.title: The Nature and Art of Financial Supervision: Reflections on a 25-Year Journey
detail.abstract: This article reflects on 25 years of experience in financial regulation and supervision, emphasising key lessons for future professionals. It underscores that effective supervision requires adaptability, independence, accountability, proactive intervention, and international cooperation. The evolution from principles-based to rules-based, and now outcomes-based regulation, highlights the need for regulators to be flexible amidst global crises, technological advances, and emerging asset classes like crypto assets. Independence is vital to resist political and industry pressures, ensuring long-term stability and credibility. Accountability and due process, supported by comprehensive audit trails and collective decision-making, reinforce transparency and public trust. Proactive intervention is essential in detecting and addressing market malpractice early, preventing systemic crises. Lastly, international cooperation is indispensable given the interconnectedness of today's financial markets, requiring trust, knowledge sharing, and coordinated oversight across borders. The article advocates for a professional and ethical approach among regulators, emphasising that integrity builds confidence in the system. These lessons aim to guide upcoming professionals in navigating complexities, fostering resilience, and maintaining the integrity and competitiveness of the global financial landscape. The overarching message is that adaptability, independence, accountability, proactive action, and international collaboration are fundamental to robust financial supervision in an ever-evolving environment.

detail.title: Institutional Mistrust and Child Vaccination Coverage in Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: Nik Stoop acknowledges financial support from Research Foundation Flanders (scholarship 12W8320N).

detail.abstract:
Despite considerable improvements in vaccination coverage over the last decade, half of the world's unvaccinated and under-vaccinated children are located in Africa. The role of institutional trust in explaining vaccination gaps has been highlighted in several qualitative reports but so far has only been quantified in a small number of high-income countries.

We matched information on child vaccination status from the Demographic Health Surveys with information on institutional trust from the Afrobarometer surveys at the sub-national level. A total of 166,953 children from 41 surveys administered in 22 African countries covering 216 sub-national regions were used. Based on a principal component analysis, we constructed an institutional mistrust index that combined the level of mistrust in the head of state, parliament, electoral system, courts and local government. Associations between institutional mistrust and child vaccination uptake were assessed with multivariable fixed effects logistic regressions that controlled for time-invariant sub-national region characteristics and various child, caregiver, household and community characteristics.

A one-standard deviation increase in the institutional mistrust index was associated with a 10% (95%-CI of odds ratios: 1.03-1.18) increase in the likelihood that a child had not received any of eight basic vaccines and with a 6% decrease in the likelihood a child had received all of the basic vaccines (95%-CI: 0.92-0.97). Institutional mistrust was negatively associated with the likelihood that a child had received each of the 8 basic vaccinations (p<0.05).

Child vaccination rates in Africa are considerably lower in areas in which the local population displays high levels of mistrust toward local authorities. Institutional mistrust is an important dimension of vaccine hesitancy, considered as one of the most important threats to global health. Empowering local authorities with resources and communication strategies to address institutional mistrust may be needed to close the remaining vaccination gaps in Africa.

title: Recent Economical Advances in Public Procurement

detail.title: Recent Economical Advances in Public Procurement
detail.abstract: This report provides a comprehensive review of recent empirical economic research in public procurement, synthesizing key findings across nine critical themes: incentives, political economy, governance, firm responses, award designs, waste, pre/post-award outcomes, regulation, and market structure. Using the World Bank procurement dataset (2018-2024), we explore nine central themes. Public procurement represents a substantial portion of global GDP, ranging from 12% to 19%, highlighting its immense economic significance and its evolving role as a strategic policy instrument beyond mere cost efficiency. The review identifies pervasive issues such as favouritism and various forms of waste, while also demonstrating the transformative potential of transparency, digital tools, and context-specific regulatory approaches. This report identifies significant research gaps, particularly in areas of social sustainability and the granular impact of emerging technologies, and proposes a framework for developing unique empirical contributions, thereby guiding aspiring researchers and informing evidence-based policy design.

title: Reciprocal Remittances: Inventive Practices, Alternative Economies, and the Differing Role of ‘Friends’

detail.title: Reciprocal Remittances: Inventive Practices, Alternative Economies, and the Differing Role of ‘Friends’

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval given by OSGA Departmental Research Ethics Committee, a subcommittee of the University of Oxford Central University Research Ethics Committee.
declarations.funderStatement: The Leverhulme Trust

detail.abstract: This article examines Venezuelan migrants’ remittance practices in Madeira and Trinidad & Tobago (T&T) to highlight how similar sounding remittance methods diverge sharply across contexts. Based on qualitative interviews, it identifies a novel system that termed “reciprocal remittances” in Madeira, whereby friends enable transfers through parallel domestic transactions in both countries. Unlike systems like hawala, these exchanges are bi-directional, non-profit, and grounded in reciprocity, allowing actors to save in euros, send reverse remittances, or gain transnational access to goods. By contrast, in T&T migrants rely on ‘friends’ who operate as profit-seeking informal agents. Here, Venezuelan migrants must pay high fees while remaining unaware of the multiple intermediaries involved. They face limited alternatives due to their undocumented status as well as T&T’s restrictive banking regulation. The article situates reciprocal remittances within Gibson-Graham’s alternative economies framework, showing how migrants repurpose financial infrastructures to create disintermediated, trust-based, non-profit transfer systems. The comparison with the situation in T&T underscores how migrants’ legal status and local fintech environments shape the viability of inventive practices. While reciprocal remittances exemplify an alternative economy rooted in reciprocity, their dependence on documentation and access to diverse infrastructures are key limitations. The article concludes by challenging the presumption that formalisation improves remittance efficiency, calling instead for greater recognition of migrant-devised practices.

title: Narcissism as a Global Barrier to Education for Sustainable Development

detail.title: Narcissism as a Global Barrier to Education for Sustainable Development
detail.abstract: Narcissism, extreme self-interest, refers to a set of personality characteristics including arrogance, self-centeredness, need for admiration, sense of entitlement, grandiosity, lack of empathy, and interpersonal exploitation, which can range from normal to a diagnosable mental disorder, narcissistic personality disorder. Narcissism, deriving from the Greek myth of Narcissus who fell in love with his reflection in a pool of water which led to his demise, is part of our human nature and is associated with aggressive behaviour, conflict and war, counterproductive work behaviour, "bad" leadership, and weaker environmental ethics. Evidence suggests that individual and collective narcissism is increasing worldwide. Correspondingly, individualism is increasing while collectivism is declining. Furthermore, leadership attracts narcissists with its allure of power and prestige, who then affect their organisations' performance, and those higher in narcissism tend to attain higher leadership levels. These trends are increasingly problematic as our world shifts toward greater interdependence. Add the challenges of narcissism with its corresponding threats to sustainable institutions to the challenges of sustainable development, "development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs" (United Nations World Commission on Environment and Development, 1987: 43), and this identifies an overlooked barrier to education for sustainable development. We developed a testable model to address this barrier. Since the determining factors for institutional sustainability are generated largely by activities of specific teams, departments, and task forces, our framework stresses interactions at the group level in education systems. This model presents seven sets of impacts of a narcissistic leader's actions upon the outcomes for her or his group, generates fourteen propositions, and outlines research strategies.

detail.abstract: Construction and infrastructure projects play a crucial role in fostering global economic growth. However, it is important to acknowledge that these projects can also give rise to conflicts, leading to undesirable consequences such as delays, escalated expenses, and strained relationships. Alternative methods are becoming more popular as conventional legal conflict resolution procedures are seen inefficient in terms of time and cost. Arbitration is a costefficient method for resolving disputes between options. This research examines the intricate dynamics of arbitration in construction and infrastructure projects, with a specific focus on its effectiveness and possible enhancements. The building and infrastructure sectors exhibit intricate contractual structures, technological hurdles, and a multitude of players, hence heightening the probability of project disputes. Effective dispute resolution is essential for ensuring project completion, adherence to contractual obligations, and fostering positive working relationships. This study examines the function of arbitration in resolving conflicts related to construction and infrastructure, in order to address this requirement. This research focuses on analysing dispute resolution in construction and infrastructure projects, specifically comparing arbitration to alternative techniques. The study identifies crucial elements that influence arbitration outcomes and provides recommendations for enhancing its effectiveness. Stakeholders can enhance conflict resolution by recognizing the effectiveness of arbitration in this particular situation. This study aims to analyse the effectiveness of arbitration in resolving construction and infrastructure disputes. It will identify the most efficient procedures and areas that require development. Additionally, it will provide strategies to enhance the application and success of arbitration in these vital industries, providing valuable insights to stakeholders. This study focuses on the analysis of arbitration as a method for resolving construction and infrastructure concerns. It aims to assess the challenges, advantages, and potential enhancements of arbitration in three key industries, with the goal of improving conflict resolution.

detail.title: TQM-Case Study Fuel Pump Recall Issue
detail.abstract: This case study applies Total Quality Management (TQM) principles to analyze the large-scale fuel pump recall by Honda Motor Co., Ltd., impacting millions of Honda and Acura vehicles worldwide between 2017 and 2023. The issue stemmed from low-density impellers in fuel pumps, which deformed during service and caused engine stalls, no-start conditions, and safety risks. Using Philip B. Crosby’s “Zero Defects” philosophy, the study emphasizes prevention over correction and conformance to requirements as a foundation of quality. Data collection tools, including control charts, revealed out-of-control events linked to impeller material density and drying times, while Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) highlighted key risk areas in molding, handling, and assembly. Recommended corrective actions included in-line density testing, accelerated aging validation, process optimization, and poka-yoke methods for material identification. Implementing these measures delivers multiple benefits: reduced warranty and recall costs, improved customer trust, higher employee engagement, waste reduction, and enhanced market share. This case underscores how TQM frameworks enable organizations to manage recalls proactively, minimize quality-related losses, and strengthen long-term competitiveness.

declarations.ethicsApproval: The surveys were conducted within the framework of a research project that received ethical clearance from the Ethics Committee for the Social Sciences and Humanities at the University of Antwerp.
declarations.funderStatement: The research was funded by Research Foundation Flanders (EOS Project 30784531 and scholarship 12W8320N); the European Union and the University of Antwerp’s Research Fund (DOCPRO – BOF scholarship FFB190256).

detail.abstract: In April 2020, the Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo was facing two major infectious disease outbreaks: Covid-19 and Ebola Virus Disease (EVD). We highlight large differences in the socioeconomic impact of these two outbreaks. The data come from a phone survey that we conducted in the period May-July 2020 with 637 households and 363 small firms from a megacity and two rural communes in the province of North Kivu. While 3,470 EVD cases and 2,287 EVD deaths were confirmed since August 2018, self reported impacts of EVD on revenues, access to food and behavior were limited. In contrast, only 251 Covid-19 cases were reported as of July 22nd but respondents reported sizable effects on livelihoods, especially in the large urban hub, and in part driven by substantial job losses. Our results show that different infectious disease outbreaks can have very different effects, largely unrelated to case numbers of the disease. Moderately lethal but highly transmissible viruses such as Covid-19 can trigger a steep economic downturn, especially in areas with high economic interconnectedness, reflecting both national and international policies to contain the pandemic.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了刚果民主共和国东部同时爆发的埃博拉病毒病和COVID-19疫情的社会经济影响，发现尽管埃博拉病例更多，但COVID-19对生计的影响更大，特别是在经济互联程度高的城市地区。
AI.research_question: 不同传染病爆发（埃博拉与COVID-19）的社会经济影响有何差异？这些差异是否与病例数量相关？
AI.motivation: 2020年4月刚果民主共和国东部同时面临埃博拉和COVID-19两种传染病爆发，需要了解它们对社会经济的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传染病经济学、公共卫生政策影响、社会经济脆弱性理论
AI.method: 2020年5-7月对北基伍省637户家庭和363家小型企业进行的电话调查
AI.findings: 埃博拉病例更多但社会经济影响有限，COVID-19病例较少但对收入、就业和生计影响显著，特别是在城市地区
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传染病的社会经济影响与病例数量不成正比，强调了传播性和政策反应的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定提供依据，强调需要针对不同传染病的特性采取差异化应对策略

title: Minimum Viable Relationships (MVR): A Relational Readiness Framework for African Ventures

detail.title: Minimum Viable Relationships (MVR): A Relational Readiness Framework for African Ventures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual/methodological paper; no human participants, personal data, or field interventions were collected or analyzed, so no IRB/ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Startups that import MVP-first logics into high-context African markets frequently stall not because products lack utility, but because ventures lack permission to operate. This paper proposes Minimum Viable Relationships (MVR) as a relational-readiness gate that precedes MVP in such contexts. MVR formalizes the conditions under which counterparties (customers, distributors, institutions) grant access without triggering social or organizational sanction. I define the construct, situate it against adjacent ideas (design thinking, diffusion of innovations), and argue that in markets where social sanction outweighs functional risk, relationship viability must be validated before product experiments can be considered valid.

The paper contributes three artifacts: (1) a seven-dimension MVR diagnostic with go/no-go thresholds that scores embeddedness, trust, guardian vouches, and channel permission; (2) an MVR Investment Memo template that enables funders to assess relational risk alongside financial and operational risk; and (3) a practical “design lab” of field tools for earning permission (pilot site commitments, data-sharing agreements, compliance pathways, and referral loops). Comparative case vignettes (e.g., SafeBoda, KOKO Networks, Wave vs. Dash, Sendy) illustrate how early permission artifacts correlate with durable traction.

The framework reframes early venture due diligence in Africa from “Can the product work?” to “Are we allowed to make it work here?” and offers testable propositions for founders, investors, and ecosystem builders. Limitations and avenues for empirical study are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"最小可行关系"（MVR）作为在高语境非洲市场中先于MVP的关系准备门槛，强调在社交制裁重于功能风险的市场中，必须先验证关系可行性才能进行产品实验。
AI.research_question: 在高语境非洲市场中，初创企业如何获得运营许可，避免因缺乏关系准备而导致项目停滞？
AI.motivation: 许多将MVP逻辑引入高语境非洲市场的初创企业停滞不前，不是因为产品缺乏实用性，而是因为缺乏运营许可。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最小可行关系（MVR）理论，与设计思维、创新扩散等相邻概念相对照。
AI.method: 提出七维度MVR诊断工具、MVR投资备忘录模板和实地工具设计实验室，并通过比较案例研究（如SafeBoda、KOKO Networks等）进行说明。
AI.findings: 在社交制裁重于功能风险的市场中，关系可行性必须优先于产品实验进行验证；早期许可工具有助于获得持久吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新构建了非洲早期创业尽职调查框架，从"产品能否工作"转向"我们是否被允许在这里使其工作"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创始人、投资者和生态系统建设者提供了可测试的命题和实用工具，包括诊断工具、投资备忘录模板和实地权限获取工具。

title: Generating the Term Structure of Interest Rates with Diffusion Models
affiliations: , University of Tokyo, Graduate School of Economics, University of Tokyo - Faculty of Economics and University of Tokyo, Graduate School of Economics

detail.title: Generating the Term Structure of Interest Rates with Diffusion Models
detail.abstract: This study introduces a novel generative modeling framework for simulating the term structure of interest rates. In recent years, generative models have achieved significant progress in image generation and are increasingly being applied to finance. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to apply a generative model-specifically, a diffusion model-to the term structure of interest rates. Furthermore, we extend the framework to incorporate conditional generation mechanisms and v-parameterization. The training dataset consists of spot yield curves constructed from daily overnight index swap (OIS) rates using cubic Hermite splines. As base conditioning variables, we use short-term interest rates and changes in consumer price indexes (CPIs). Empirical analysis covering the period from 2015 to 2025 demonstrates that our model successfully reproduces the level and shape of yield curves corresponding to historical macroeconomic conditions and short-term interest rate environments. Additionally, when incorporating further conditioning variables related to quantitative easing policies, monetary base, current account balances, and nominal gross domestic product (GDP), we find that the inclusion of quantitative easing indicator notably enhances the model's output relative to the base conditioning case. This suggests improved robustness and representational capacity under expanded conditioning.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次将扩散模型应用于利率期限结构的生成建模，通过条件生成机制和v参数化扩展框架，实证表明模型能成功复现历史宏观经济条件下的收益率曲线形态，量化宽松指标的加入显著提升了模型表现。
AI.research_question: 如何应用生成模型（特别是扩散模型）来模拟利率期限结构？
AI.motivation: 近年来生成模型在图像生成领域取得显著进展，并逐渐应用于金融领域，但尚未有研究将其应用于利率期限结构的建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成建模框架、扩散模型、条件生成机制、v参数化
AI.method: 使用三次Hermite样条从每日隔夜指数掉期利率构建即期收益率曲线作为训练数据集，以短期利率和CPI变化作为基础条件变量
AI.findings: 模型成功复现了与历史宏观经济条件和短期利率环境相对应的收益率曲线水平和形状；加入量化宽松政策、货币基础、经常账户余额和名义GDP等额外条件变量后，量化宽松指标的加入显著提升了模型输出效果
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将扩散模型应用于利率期限结构建模，扩展了生成模型在金融领域的应用范围
AI.practical_contributions: 为利率期限结构的模拟提供了新的建模框架，在风险管理、资产定价和货币政策分析等方面具有实际应用价值

title: Macro Determinants of Global Financial Inclusion: Evidence from World Data
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Macro Determinants of Global Financial Inclusion: Evidence from World Data
detail.abstract: The study investigates the macro determinants of global financial inclusion using world data from 1999 to 2023 period. The data were analysed using the fully modified ordinary least squares regression estimator, the two-stage least squares regression estimator and the robust least squares regression estimator. The determinants examined are total domestic investment, macroeconomic management frameworks, international trade openness, total population size, consumer spending, and economic growth rate. The findings reveal that population size and trade openness have a positive effect on global financial inclusion through a higher financial inclusion index and commercial bank branch expansion. Total domestic investment and sound macroeconomic management have a negative effect on global financial inclusion through a decrease in the financial inclusion index and a reduction in the number of bank branches and the negative effect is more pronounced in the post-financial crisis years. However, total population size remain a positive determinant of global financial inclusion in the post-financial crisis years. Trade openness and consumer spending increase global financial inclusion during periods of economic prosperity while total domestic investment and sound macroeconomic management decrease global financial inclusion during periods of economic prosperity. In terms of forward-looking orientation, the study finds that a large population and weak macroeconomic management in the present period leads to financial inclusion gains in the future. It is recommended that policy adjustments in today's population size and macroeconomic management frameworks can help to achieve future financial inclusion targets. The findings contribute to the financial inclusion literature by using world data to offer new insights into the factors that can accelerate global financial inclusion.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用1999-2023年全球数据分析金融包容性的宏观决定因素，发现人口规模和贸易开放度对金融包容性有正向影响，而国内总投资和健全的宏观经济管理有负向影响。
AI.research_question: 全球金融包容性的宏观决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究全球金融包容性的决定因素，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、宏观经济管理理论
AI.method: 使用完全修正普通最小二乘法、两阶段最小二乘法和稳健最小二乘法回归分析1999-2023年全球数据
AI.findings: 人口规模和贸易开放度对金融包容性有正向影响，国内总投资和健全的宏观经济管理有负向影响，且在经济繁荣时期这种影响更为明显
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融包容性文献提供了基于全球数据的新见解，揭示了决定因素的时间动态特征
AI.practical_contributions: 建议通过调整人口规模和宏观经济管理政策来实现未来的金融包容性目标

title: Self-Belief - The Unknown Paradox

detail.title: Self-Belief - The Unknown Paradox

declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper examines the foundational assumptions that self-belief is internal and a personal trait. It explores the paradox, that self-belief, especially for leaders, is not entirely self-generated. But emerges from the dynamic interplay between internal clarity and external perception. It aims to redefine self-belief as a relational construct and introduce new model-'The Self Belief Matrix, which can help to decode and develop belief is leadership contexts. Social Implications Misaligned self-belief especially in leadership roles can subtly erode team morale, decision making speed and trust amongst the team. Creating psychological safe environments where feedback is moralized and internal narratives are challenged many enhance not just the leader's confidence but also team cohesion and collective resilience. Conclusion As thought earlier, self-belief is not just a fire within. It is light seen when others reflect back what the leader really wants to become. This paper provides a new direction for leadership development. Belief Engineering, a new concept to design and align self-belief as a relational force that can be deciphered, coached and cultivated.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了自我信念是内在个人特质的传统观点，提出自我信念是内部清晰度与外部感知动态互动的结果，并引入'自我信念矩阵'模型来解码和发展领导力情境中的信念。
AI.research_question: 领导者的自我信念是如何形成的？它是否纯粹是内在的个人特质？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为自我信念是内在的个人特质，但现实中领导者的自我信念往往受到外部反馈和感知的影响，这种错位可能导致团队士气下降、决策速度减慢和信任受损。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我信念的关系建构理论，挑战传统的内在特质观点
AI.method: 概念性分析，提出'自我信念矩阵'模型
AI.findings: 自我信念是内部清晰度与外部感知的动态互动结果，而非纯粹的内在特质
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义自我信念为关系性建构，引入'自我信念矩阵'模型
AI.practical_contributions: 提供领导力发展新方向-信念工程，帮助领导者设计、调整和培养自我信念

title: Self-Reported Food Insecurity in Africa During the Food Price Crisis
affiliations: University of Antwerp - Institute of Development Policy and Management, , KU Leuven - Center for Economic Studies and International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI)

detail.title: Self-Reported Food Insecurity in Africa During the Food Price Crisis
detail.abstract: This article analyzes data on self-reported food insecurity of more than 50,000 individuals in 18 Sub-Saharan African countries over the period 2005-2008, when global food prices increased dramatically. The average level of self-reported food insecurity was high but remarkably stable over time, at about 54%. However, this average hides large heterogeneity, both within countries and across countries. In eight of the sample countries, self-reported food security improved, while it worsened in the ten other countries. Our results suggest that heterogeneous effects in self-reported food security are consistent with economic predictions, as they are correlated with economic growth and net food consumption (both at the household and country level). Specifically, in the face of rising food prices, self-reported food security improved on average in rural households, while it worsened in urban households-a finding that holds when using global prices or domestic food prices. Improvements in food security over time were also positively correlated with net food exports and GDP per capita growth. While the self-reported indicator used in this paper requires further study and one should carefully interpret the results, our findings suggest the need for a critical evaluation of the currently used data and numbers in the public debate on food prices and food insecurity.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2005-2008年全球粮食价格飙升期间，18个撒哈拉以南非洲国家5万多名个体的粮食不安全自评数据。研究发现平均粮食不安全水平高达54%但相对稳定，但存在显著异质性：8个国家改善，10个国家恶化。农村家庭粮食安全改善，城市家庭恶化，这与经济增长和净粮食消费相关。
AI.research_question: 全球粮食价格上涨期间，撒哈拉以南非洲国家粮食不安全状况如何变化？影响这些变化的因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 2005-2008年全球粮食价格大幅上涨，但缺乏对撒哈拉以南非洲地区粮食不安全状况变化的系统性分析，需要了解价格冲击对不同群体和国家的异质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济理论，粮食价格变化对粮食安全的影响取决于家庭和国家的净粮食消费状况（生产者vs消费者）以及经济增长水平。
AI.method: 使用2005-2008年18个撒哈拉以南非洲国家5万多名个体的自评粮食不安全数据，结合全球和国内粮食价格数据，进行相关性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 平均粮食不安全水平稳定在54%；2) 存在显著异质性：8个国家改善，10个国家恶化；3) 农村家庭粮食安全改善，城市家庭恶化；4) 改善与净粮食出口和人均GDP增长正相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了经济理论预测：粮食价格冲击的影响取决于净粮食消费状况，为理解价格变化对粮食安全的异质性影响提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 揭示粮食价格政策需考虑城乡差异；2) 质疑当前公共辩论中使用的粮食不安全数据的可靠性；3) 为针对性政策制定提供实证依据。

title: Differences Between Basketball Players And 15-Year-Old Students in Some Anthropometric Features and Motor Skills
affiliations: AAB College, , AAB College, AAB College, University of Pristina and AAB College

detail.title: Differences Between Basketball Players And 15-Year-Old Students in Some Anthropometric Features and Motor Skills

declarations.funderStatement: Yes

detail.abstract: The research was conducted on a sample of 100 young pupils aged 14-15, in two schools; the first one was an elementary school and the second was a basketball club from Priština. The purpose of the study was to prove the possible difference between the basketball players and the pupils in some anthropometric characteristics, basic motor skills and situational motor skills. In order to define these changes of anthropometric characteristics, 18 variables were applied for basic motor and situational motor skills. The survey data were processed with descriptive statistical methods and through a T-test. The results show that there are statistically significant differences and that there is a statistically significant difference between basketball players and pupils, where basketball players have better results in all tests of basic motor and situational motor skills. The results have shown that the regular engagement of children in basketball schools can enhance the skills and knowledge of young players and make a significant difference.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了100名14-15岁篮球运动员与普通学生在身体特征、基本运动技能和情境运动技能方面的差异，发现篮球运动员在所有测试中表现更好，表明参与篮球训练能显著提升青少年运动能力。
AI.research_question: 篮球运动员与普通学生在身体特征、基本运动技能和情境运动技能方面是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 探究系统性篮球训练对青少年运动能力发展的影响，为青少年体育教育提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于运动训练学、青少年生长发育理论和运动技能习得理论。
AI.method: 采用18个变量测量身体特征、基本运动技能和情境运动技能，对100名14-15岁学生（包括篮球俱乐部成员和普通学生）进行测试，使用描述性统计和T检验分析数据。
AI.findings: 篮球运动员在所有基本运动技能和情境运动技能测试中均显著优于普通学生，存在统计学显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了系统性运动训练对青少年运动能力发展的积极影响，丰富了青少年运动发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为青少年篮球训练项目提供了实证支持，强调了早期专业化训练的重要性，对体育教育政策制定具有参考价值。

title: Determination of the Welfare Status of Cyprinus Carpio (Linnaeus 1758) Reared in a Recirculating System by Analyzing the Hematological Profile
affiliations: Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură, Dunarea de Jos University of Galati, Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură, Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură, Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură and Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură

detail.title: Determination of the Welfare Status of Cyprinus Carpio (Linnaeus 1758) Reared in a Recirculating System by Analyzing the Hematological Profile
detail.abstract: This paper aims is to determine the welfare status of juvenile carp of different sizes and classes of the same age, by analyzing the main hematological parameters. The blood metabolic profile investigations provide valuable information regarding the physiological status of the cultured biomass. They can thus evaluate the hematologic response of juvenile carp reared under controlled conditions in a recirculating system, after being divided into four size classes (V1B1- Average body mass- 44,45 g/ex., V2B2-Average body mass- 63.85 g/ex., V3B3-Average body mass- 89.98 g/ex., V4B4-Average body mass- 141.5 g/ex.). The hemoglobin value, both at the beginning and end of the experiment, can be described as normal for this stage of development. The low hematocrit value (between 25 and 28 %) in the 4 experimental variants is possibly associated with an inadequate biochemical composition of the feed in terms of the presence of vitamins and some trace elements. The erythrocyte count values fall within the normal values for the species studied (1.10-2.20 mil/μl), with values that do not vary statistically (p>0.05) between the beginning and the end of the experiment for the 4 size categories. The erythrocyte constants HEM and CHEM recorded reduced values in the V3B3 growth variant at the initiation of the experiment while VEM recorded a higher value. In the other growth variants and at the two moments of the experiment (initial and final), the values of the three erythrocyte constants fall within the range of normal values for the species studied. The general conclusion resulting from the analysis of the main hematological indicators showed that the physiological state of health of the carp was not significantly influenced by the size class. After correlating the blood metabolic profile quantitatively with the indicators of technological performance, we can say that the crop biomass gains were higher in the case of larger than in the case of smaller specimens.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析主要血液学参数，评估了不同体型但同龄的幼鲤福利状况。研究发现，体型类别对鲤鱼的生理健康状态没有显著影响，但较大的个体获得了更高的生物量增长。
AI.research_question: 不同体型但同龄的幼鲤福利状况如何？体型类别是否影响其生理健康状态？
AI.motivation: 血液代谢谱分析能为养殖生物量的生理状态提供有价值的信息，有助于评估在循环系统中养殖的幼鲤的血液学响应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于血液学参数分析动物福利的理论框架，重点关注血红蛋白、血细胞比容、红细胞计数等关键血液指标。
AI.method: 将同龄幼鲤分为四个体型类别（平均体重分别为44.45g、63.85g、89.98g、141.5g），在循环系统中进行受控养殖，分析主要血液学参数的变化。
AI.findings: 1) 血红蛋白值在实验前后均正常；2) 血细胞比容值偏低（25-28%），可能与饲料中维生素和微量元素不足有关；3) 红细胞计数在正常范围内且无显著变化；4) 体型类别对生理健康状态无显著影响；5) 较大个体获得更高的生物量增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 为鱼类福利评估提供了基于血液学参数的实证依据，证实了体型差异对同龄鱼类生理状态的影响有限。

title: A Characterization of Black’s Voting Rule∗
affiliations: Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona and University of Montreal Department of Economics

detail.title: A Characterization of Black’s Voting Rule∗
detail.abstract: In his 1958 classic, The Theory of Committees and Elections, Duncan Black proposed the following lexicographic rule: for any set of feasible alternatives, and any profile of voters' goodness relations, choose the strong Condorcet winner if it exists, and select the set of Borda winners otherwise. We provide what we think is the first axiomatic characterization of this rule. We do so through the intermediary study of the generalized social welfare functions that underlie the rule's choices, and the use of axioms that emphasize what is common and what is different in the spirit of the amply debated proposals made by these two 18 th-century authors. Journal of Economic Literature Classification Nos.: D71, D72, D63.

title: More than Money: The Role of Preferences on Wealth Mobility
affiliations: Stockholm School of Economics - Finance Department and Stockholm School of Economics - Department of Finance

detail.title: More than Money: The Role of Preferences on Wealth Mobility
detail.abstract: We estimate the preferences of individuals from different wealth backgrounds to explain intergenerational wealth mobility. We use rich micro-level data on the balance sheets, consumption, and risky investments of Swedish residents, together with family wealth background measured during the offspring's early adulthood. We find that patience and risk tolerance are strongly correlated with wealth background. Counterfactual analyses reveal that background-dependent preferences can explain at least 75 percent of the wealth gap between adults of non-rich backgrounds (90 percent of the population) and very-rich backgrounds (2.5 percent of the population). In contrast, early-adulthood heterogeneity in wealth, gifts and inheritances, and intergenerational transmission of human capital are not dominant determinants of wealth mobility.

detail.abstract: While many of the European Union's (EU) economic sectors successfully reduced emissions before the COVID-19 pandemic, transport and aviation in particular showed the opposite trend. With the Fit for 55 package, the EU initiated a political push to drive the sustainable transition in aviation. Taking into account the policy drive of the Fit for 55 package, we investigate the political market intervention in intra-European aviation, considering the potential role of sustainable aviation fuels (SAFs). For this purpose, an agent-based simulation modeling approach coupled with a system dynamics environment was developed to analyze market developments through both economic and ecological lenses. Two key stakeholders, customers (both passengers and freight companies) and airlines, are considered to capture the impacts of their behaviors and decision-making preferences in the adoption of SAFs. Several scenarios, based on different policy interventions, were considered in the analysis in order to comprehensively explore the impacts of further political developments. The results indicate that policy intervention can lead to a transition driven by sustainable sector performance and demand effects in response to price changes. Furthermore, as intended by the regulations, the results suggest that achieving the sustainable transition requires a shared responsibility amongst customers, industry players, and policymakers. While the sector will reduce its relative and absolute emissions, achieving a 90% reduction compared to 1990 levels seems unlikely with current regulatory instruments.

title: A Monte Carlo Study of Super Saturation for Detecting Outliers and Location Shifts
affiliations: Magdalen College, University of Oxford

detail.title: A Monte Carlo Study of Super Saturation for Detecting Outliers and Location Shifts
detail.abstract: Unmodelled outliers and location shifts can cause serious problems for empirical modelling. Super saturation, a combination of impulse and step indicator saturation, has been used in the literature to detect outliers and location shifts of unknown magnitude and timing. However, its properties have not yet been systematically assessed. Therefore, this paper conducts a Monte Carlo study of the performance of super saturation. To account for the fact that many different combinations of indicators can model an outlier or location shift, we suggest new evaluation measures based on the classical measures of gauge and potency. We find that super saturation reaches high detection rates of outliers and location shifts, with benefits to subsequent inference and model selection. However, to control the risk of retaining too many irrelevant indicators and thereby overfitting the model, we recommend using tight significance levels for selection and turning parsimonious encompassing tests off during the indicator search.

AI.tldr: 本文通过蒙特卡洛研究评估了超级饱和方法在检测异常值和位置偏移方面的性能，提出了基于gauge和potency的新评估指标，发现该方法检测率高但需要严格控制显著性水平以避免过拟合。

title: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and WTO Law: Is the EU's CBAM Compatible with WTO Regulations?

detail.title: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and WTO Law: Is the EU's CBAM Compatible with WTO Regulations?

declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded; no external funding was received.

detail.abstract: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, introduced by Regulation (EU) 2023/956 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 10 May 2023 establishing a carbon border adjustment mechanism (hereinafter ‘CBAM’), represents one of the major steps of the European Union (hereinafter ‘EU’) to combat carbon leakage. Since CBAM is currently in its transitional phase till December 31, 2025, the implications are still debatable. Nevertheless, many countries have already expressed concerns about the potential “protectionist” nature of CBAM. During the transitional period of CBAM, importers of specific goods — including iron, steel, cement, fertilizers, aluminium, hydrogen, and electricity — are required to report the embedded greenhouse gas emissions (hereinafter GHG) associated with their imports. After all, CBAM will apply in its definitive regime from 2026. Mainly, the writing of this thesis is inspired by the ongoing “European Green Deal” (hereinafter Green Deal), which aims to reduce net greenhouse gas emissions by at least 55% by 2030, compared to 1990 levels. The Green Deal, which was first presented in 2020, established the foundation for a series of measures aimed at making the EU climate-neutral by 2050. CBAM, as a main component of this agenda, is designed to equalize the carbon cost between domestic products subject to the EU Emissions Trading System and imports from third countries that may not impose similar carbon pricing mechanisms. The compatibility of CBAM with the World Trade Organization's (hereinafter WTO) legal framework is a vast area of research. The author in this thesis examines whether CBAM is a discriminatory trade measure that violates fundamental WTO principles, such as Most Favored Nation (hereinafter MFN) and National Treatment (hereinafter NT) under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (hereinafter GATT) 1994. Overall, this thesis is structured into three main parts: first, an overview of the legal nature and framework of both CBAM and the WTO; second, a comparative analysis of CBAM in light of WTO provisions; and third, an exploration of the possible legal ways for challenging CBAM. The thesis additionally examines the legal remedies available to non-EU countries that desire to contest CBAM, including the analysis of the WTO Dispute Settlement Body.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）是否符合WTO法律框架，重点探讨了CBAM是否违反WTO的非歧视原则（最惠国待遇和国民待遇），并研究了非欧盟国家挑战CBAM的法律途径。

title: Inference on Semiparametric Single-index Conditional Factor Models with Instrument Selection
affiliations: , Aarhus University - Department of Economics and Business Economics and

detail.title: Inference on Semiparametric Single-index Conditional Factor Models with Instrument Selection
detail.abstract: This paper studies estimation and variable selection in semiparametric conditional latent factor models where both factor loadings and intercepts are formulated as nonlinear functions of certain characteristic variables. To simultaneously perform variable selection, control dimensionality, and maintain interpretability, we specify single-index structures for these unknown link functions. We propose an estimation procedure called Adaptive-PCA, which employs sieve approximation and singular value decomposition (SVD) to estimate the unknown link functions and latent factors, and applies adaptive LASSO to identify the relevant characteristics. In addition, a weighted bootstrap procedure is developed to test the null hypothesis of zero intercepts, which plays an important role when applying the proposed model to asset pricing. Theoretical properties of the proposed estimation and testing procedures are established under both large-(N, T) and large-N-but-small-T asymptotics. Applying the method to forecast constituent-level returns of the S&P 500 with 95 characteristics on the U.S. stock market, we document that approximately one-third of the variables are effective and that the resulting model delivers markedly improved out-of-sample prediction performance relative to existing benchmarks, underscoring the importance of characteristics selection in asset-pricing applications.

detail.title: Assessing the Impact of Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (MKUY) on Preventing Child Marriage in Bihar, India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.

detail.abstract: Enhancing girls' educational attainment has shown potential in reducing child marriage. This study assesses the impact of the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (MKUY), a conditional cash transfer program launched in 2018 in Bihar, India, on reducing child marriage rates among adolescent girls. While child marriage is illegal, the practice persists because of patriarchal norms, dowry systems, and limited access to secondary education. By providing monetary incentives to girls, conditional upon educational progression and remaining unmarried until 18, the scheme aims to address the social and economic determinants of early marriage. Using a robust triple difference (DDD) estimation strategy and data from the multiple rounds of the National Family Health Survey, the study finds a statistically significant 10.7 % decline in child marriage for girls aged 15-18 exposed to MKUY, relative to a comparable control group. To ensure the reliability of the estimates, parallel trend analysis and a placebo test have been conducted as a robustness check. The findings from this study add to a growing body of evidence that conditional cash transfer programs may facilitate social transformation in low-income settings and support progress toward Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) related to gender equality.

detail.title: Fiscal Drag in Theory and in Practice: A European Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive characterization of “fiscal drag”—the increase in tax revenue that occurs when nominal tax bases grow but nominal parameters of progressive tax legislation are not updated accordingly—across 21 European countries using a microsimulationapproach. First, we estimate tax-to-base elasticities, showing that the progressivity built in each country’s personal income tax system induces elasticities around 1.7–2 for many countries, indicating a potential for large fiscal drag effects. We unpack these elasticities to show stark heterogeneity in their underlying mechanisms (tax brackets or tax deductions and credits), across income sources (labor, capital, self-employment, public benefits), and across the individual income distribution. Second, we extend the analysis beyond these elasticities to study fiscal drag in practice between 2019 and 2023, incorporating observed income growth and legislative changes. We quantify the actual impact of fiscal drag and the extent to which government policies have offset it, either through indexation or other reforms. Our results provide new insights into the fiscal and distributional effects of fiscal drag in Europe, as well as useful statistics for modeling public finances.

detail.abstract: India’s rapid digitisation has expanded connectivity, yet the educational and cognitive implications of stratified media use remain underexplored. This study employed a cross-sectional, stratified multivariate design across four North-Indian regions (N = 1992, retention = 91.4%), modelling associations between media exposure and educational interest, digital literacy, and information evaluation, while testing demographic contrasts. Instruments measuring cognitive–psychosocial constructs demonstrated strong internal reliability (α > 0.84). Media-exposure metrics were z-standardised prior to analysis. Independent-samples t-tests revealed no significant gender differences in educational interest (t(1990) = −0.87, p = 0.382, d = 0.04), digital literacy (t(1990) = −0.61, p = 0.542, d = 0.03), trust in media (t(1990) = 0.54, p = 0.589, d = 0.02), peer influence (t(1990) = 0.95, p = 0.342, d = 0.04), media-hours (t(1990) = 0.11, p = 0.910, d = 0.01), or platforms used (t(1990) = 0.00, p = 0.998, d = 0.00). Likewise, one-way ANOVAs showed no age effects on educational interest, digital literacy, information evaluation, trust, or peer influence (all p > 0.16). Findings highlight demographic convergence by gender and age across media-linked educational outcomes, suggesting stratification is shaped less by basic demographic categories than by socio-cultural and contextual factors. This large-scale, India-specific design contributes precise nulls that refine digital-divide theory beyond age/gender heuristics.

title: Optimal Tax-Timing Strategy in the Presence of Transaction Costs
affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Nanchang University - School of Economics and Management and Washington University in St. Louis - Olin Business School

detail.title: Optimal Tax-Timing Strategy in the Presence of Transaction Costs
detail.abstract: Although prevalent in the financial markets, transaction costs have been largely ignored in the existing literature on the impact of capital gains tax. We develop a dynamic portfolio model that incorporates both transaction costs and annually payable capital gains taxes. We theoretically characterize and numerically compute the optimal tax-timing strategy. We show that our model can help explain the puzzle that even when investors face  equal long-term/short-term capital gains tax rates, they may still defer realizing large capital losses and vary the realization strategies of capital gains and losses across months in a calendar year. In addition, our model provides some  unique, empirically testable implications, such as (1) investors with capital losses may purchase a large number of shares without realizing any losses; and (2) investors' trading may increase with transaction costs.

detail.abstract: The Hague Apostille Convention simplified the process of cross-border document authentication by standardizing procedures for apostille certification. In the context of transnational legal transactions, especially between the United States and Latin American jurisdictions, the apostille has become indispensable. This paper examines the historical development of the Convention, its adoption in the Americas, and its contemporary role in facilitating international commerce, migration, and legal recognition of documents. Practical considerations highlight the increasing demand for apostille services in Florida, with Miami-Dade County serving as a central hub for document authentication and certification. The discussion further considers emerging challenges in digital apostille systems and the growing reliance on specialized service providers that assist individuals and businesses in navigating complex requirements.

title: Paying to Run: Withdrawal Fees and Effects on Banking Panic

detail.title: Paying to Run: Withdrawal Fees and Effects on Banking Panic
detail.abstract: The chronic vulnerability of banks to panic runs, particularly on uninsured deposits, could be mitigated by introducing a withdrawal fee that increases monotonically with aggregate withdrawal demand. The policy is implemented directly into the deposit contract and analyzed through global games, preserving the single threshold equilibrium, to study its effects on the endogenous probability of a run in the panic region, and thereby on financial stability. Withdrawal fees are found to reduce panic runs unambiguously; however, new trade-offs emerge in how the bank uses the collected fees. When fee proceeds are permanently removed from circulation (burning regime), the policy increases the deposit rate (better risk-sharing), lowers the ex ante probability of a run, and is welfare superior relative to the no-fee benchmark, but the system forfeits fee-based liquidity. By contrast, when collected fees are used to finance a partial insurance scheme for waiting depositors in states of poor fundamentals, liquidity creation improves, fragility decreases further, but depositors' welfare is lower. The model and results add to the literature and policy discussions on bank fragility.

detail.abstract: As a terrible communal hate crime and a mirror of India's wider erosion of constitutional morality, the Belagavi school poisoning is examined in the essay "Poisoned Adults Poison Children" (EPW, 30 Aug 2025). This letter reacts to the article by emphasising that the occurrence is the result of years of bigotry that has become normalised, strengthened by media silence and government collusion. It contends that unless cultural principles are transformed into lived constitutional ethics, administrative measures such as school safety rules are insufficient. By placing the conversation inside Karnataka's own reform history, which includes the Sharanas, Vitthal Ramji Shinde, and A M Sayyad, the letter emphasises how plurality and unity are ingrained in our culture.

title: Build What and for Whom? The Distributional Effects of Housing Supply

detail.title: Build What and for Whom? The Distributional Effects of Housing Supply
detail.abstract: New construction has favored bigger, more expensive houses. This paper studies the causes of this pattern and evaluates the equilibrium impacts of proposed housing policies aimed at improving affordability at the lower end of the market. I develop an equilibrium model of segmented housing markets with two key features: (1) heterogeneous household preferences for housing quality by demographics, and (2) endogenous housing supply with heterogeneous development costs by housing quality. Using microdata on household housing choices and parcel-specific development costs for single-family homes in the Atlanta MSA, I find that the shift toward large home construction is partly driven by demand from high-income households, who are less price-sensitive and prefer larger homes, but zoning density restrictions play a more significant role in limiting the construction of smaller homes. Relaxing these restrictions could expand the supply of small homes and benefit low-income households, but such zoning reforms are often politically challenging. As an alternative, I evaluate the impact of recently proposed housing subsidies targeting first-time homebuyers and starter homes. The model predicts that subsidizing young, low-income households provides substantial targeted welfare gains to recipients but hurts others due to rising prices. By contrast, subsidies to small home construction increase the supply of small homes but crowd out the construction of larger homes, resulting in modest welfare gains without effectively targeting those most in need.

title: Get a Skill, Get a Job, Get Ahead? Evaluating the Effects of Virginia’s Workforce-Targeted Free College Program
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania and University of Arkansas

detail.title: Get a Skill, Get a Job, Get Ahead? Evaluating the Effects of Virginia’s Workforce-Targeted Free College Program
detail.abstract: Tuition-free college programs are gaining momentum as policymakers address rising college costs and workforce readiness. Despite their growing adoption, limited research examines how workforce-focused eligibility criteria impact student outcomes beyond enrollment. This pre-registered study employs two within-study quasi-experimental designs---difference-in-discontinuity and difference-in-differences--- to estimate the causal impact of Virginia's Get a Skill, Get a Job, Get Ahead (G3) initiative on financial aid and academic outcomes for community college students. Launched as a pandemic recovery effort, G3 aimed to reverse enrollment declines and address labor shortages by leveraging simplified ‘free college’ messaging and offering last-dollar scholarships and additional advising support for students in high-demand workforce programs. We find that G3 significantly increased FAFSA completion, total financial aid, and grant aid, with gains concentrated among middle-income students. The program also reduced student borrowing, consistent with crowd-out by grant aid. Certificate completion rose by 5.1 to 6.6 percentage points, and higher enrollment translated these gains into a net increase in the number of students earning certificates in targeted fields. These findings suggest workforce-targeted tuition-free programs can expand financial aid access, increase the supply of certified workers in priority fields, and better align higher education with workforce demands.

title: Uncovering Upskilling Paths in Online Labor Markets: A Linear Dynamical System
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Carnegie Mellon University and Singapore Management University - School of Computing and Information Systems

detail.title: Uncovering Upskilling Paths in Online Labor Markets: A Linear Dynamical System
detail.abstract: Specialization is an emerging phenomenon in online labor markets such as Upwork and Freelancer. Although the literature has extensively studied spillovers of related and focal experience on worker performance, much less is understood about how workers learn from accumulated experience within a focal category in online labor markets. Thus, we examine how platforms can refine predictions of worker performance via modeling their individual learning processes over time. We develop a linear dynamical system to predict ratings given to workers via estimating their calibrated latent quality (CALQ) over time. Each individual worker's quality evolution is Markovian and influenced by the characteristics of the worker-project pair. We evaluate our model on a large-scale panel dataset from a major online labor market and show that the model improves the prediction accuracy by up to 33% over a standard baseline, both in the literature and in practice. We further validate its significant accuracy improvement and parsimonious model structure against an autoregression and a recurrent neural network. Estimation results of the model uncover the double-edged influence of project size, reflected in the project earnings and duration, on observable ratings and CALQ evolution. Specifically, completing a large project lowers a worker's expected rating, but upon successful completion, this experience can significantly enhance the CALQ development. We further uncover workers' average CALQ development paths (i.e., upskilling paths) in different categories, hidden under a counterintuitive decline in the average ratings. As far as we know, we are the first to quantify the double-edged influence of project size in online labor markets, which in turn yields a more accurate quality estimate, i.e., CALQ. Due to the negative influence of project size on ratings in the status quo rating system, workers tend to select small projects to maintain a good reputation, i.e., reputation myopia. Therefore, size-adjusted worker quality estimates can help platforms nudge workers toward suitable upskilling opportunities and manage workforce capability based on historical data. This is especially crucial under demand-side shocks arising from, e.g., AI technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个线性动态系统模型(CALQ)来预测在线劳动力市场中工人的质量演变，发现项目规模对工人评级和潜在质量发展具有双重影响，模型预测精度比基准方法提高33%。
AI.research_question: 平台如何通过建模工人的个体学习过程来改进对工人绩效的预测？
AI.motivation: 在线劳动力市场中，虽然文献广泛研究了相关经验和焦点经验对工人绩效的溢出效应，但对工人在焦点类别内从积累经验中学习的过程了解甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性动态系统理论、马尔可夫过程、工人质量演化模型
AI.method: 开发线性动态系统模型来估计工人的校准潜在质量(CALQ)，使用来自主要在线劳动力市场的大规模面板数据集进行评估。
AI.findings: 项目规模对可观察评级和CALQ演化具有双重影响：完成大型项目会降低工人的预期评级，但成功完成后能显著增强CALQ发展；发现工人平均CALQ发展路径隐藏在平均评级反直觉下降之下。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化在线劳动力市场中项目规模的双重影响，提出更准确的质量估计方法CALQ；揭示声誉短视现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 模型预测精度比标准基准提高33%；平台可以使用大小调整的工人质量估计来推动工人走向合适的技能提升机会，基于历史数据管理劳动力能力，特别是在AI技术等需求侧冲击下。

title: Beyond the Benchmark: Magic Formula Outperformance in Indian Equity Markets
affiliations: Independent, Independent and Independent

detail.title: Beyond the Benchmark: Magic Formula Outperformance in Indian Equity Markets
detail.abstract: Most existing studies on the Magic Formula strategy have been conducted in the context of developed markets, while research in the Indian setting has remained limited and largely exploratory. The present study implements and evaluates the Magic Formula in the Indian equity market, focusing on NIFTY 100 constituents from 2007 to 2024. The Magic Formula, introduced by Joel Greenblatt, ranks firms based on earnings yield and return on capital to identify undervalued yet profitable companies. Using annual financial data and adjusted stock prices, we construct portfolios following the standard Magic Formula rules and compare their performance with the NIFTY 50 benchmark. Our findings reveal that even the unmodified version of the Magic Formula outperforms the benchmark substantially, generating approximately 1.7 times higher returns over the study period. These results are particularly notable given that the test universe consists of large, liquid, and relatively low-risk firms. The evidence suggests that extending the strategy to broader indices such as the NIFTY 250 or NIFTY 500 could yield even stronger results, underscoring the potential of systematic value-based approaches in Indian equity markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究在印度股市实施并评估了魔法公式策略，发现即使在大型低风险股票中，该策略也能显著跑赢基准指数，为印度市场的价值投资策略提供了实证支持。
AI.research_question: 魔法公式策略在印度股市是否有效？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要集中在发达市场，印度市场的研究有限且多为探索性研究，需要系统评估该策略在印度市场的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 乔尔·格林布拉特的魔法公式理论，基于收益收益率和资本回报率筛选被低估但盈利的公司。
AI.method: 使用2007-2024年NIFTY 100成分股的年度财务数据和调整后股价，按照标准魔法公式规则构建投资组合，并与NIFTY 50基准进行比较。
AI.findings: 未经修改的魔法公式策略显著跑赢基准，在研究期间产生约1.7倍的更高回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了魔法公式策略在印度新兴市场的有效性，扩展了该策略的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度投资者提供了有效的价值投资策略，建议扩展到更广泛的指数如NIFTY 250或NIFTY 500可能获得更好结果。

title: How Does Artificial Intelligence Contribute to Anti-Corruption: Theory and Evidence from an Initiative in Brazil
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Tsinghua University and Tsinghua University

detail.title: How Does Artificial Intelligence Contribute to Anti-Corruption: Theory and Evidence from an Initiative in Brazil
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has penetrated into public management and attracted growing academic attention. But research in this direction is at an early stage, let alone evidence-based studies. Our research investigates the functions of AI when it is embedded into anti-corruption E-governance. We develop a theoretical framework that explains how AI transforms the mode of public participation from a 'passive machine, active citizen' pattern to an 'active machine, passive citizen' paradigm. Empirical evidence from a Brazilian initiative, 'Operation Serenata de Amor', supports our theoretical insights, demonstrating that the AI-enabled initiative significantly reduced irregular reimbursement behaviour in Brazil's Chamber of Deputies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了人工智能在反腐败电子政务中的功能，提出了从'被动机器、主动公民'到'主动机器、被动公民'的公共参与模式转变理论框架，并通过巴西'Operation Serenata de Amor'项目的实证证据证实了AI能显著减少议员报销违规行为。
AI.research_question: 人工智能嵌入反腐败电子政务时发挥什么功能？
AI.motivation: 人工智能已渗透到公共管理领域并引起学术关注，但该方向研究尚处于早期阶段，特别是缺乏基于证据的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI将公共参与模式从'被动机器、主动公民'转变为'主动机器、被动公民'的理论框架。
AI.method: 基于巴西'Operation Serenata de Amor'项目的实证研究。
AI.findings: AI支持的项目显著减少了巴西众议院的不规范报销行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI在公共管理中转变参与模式的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反腐败电子政务提供了AI应用的有效实践案例，展示了AI在减少政府腐败方面的实际效果。

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has shown strong potential in medicine, particularly in oncology, dermatology, and radiology. However, its application in mental health care remains limited due to insufficient data availability. This research investigates knowledge-sharing practices among mental health practitioners to determine how data can be effectively captured and utilized for AI integration. Using qualitative interviews and surveys with mental health professionals identifies barriers such as time constraints, digital skills gaps, resistance to change, and ethical concerns under GDPR, while also highlighting potential benefits of AI, including early detection of behavioural patterns, improved diagnosis, and enhanced patient independence. Nevertheless, respondents recognised AI's potential to support earlier detection of behavioural patterns, enhance communication, and improve patient independence. By applying Nonaka's SECI model to mental health knowledge flows, this study proposes the Knowledge-Sharing AI Model (KSAI-Model). The model illustrates how tacit clinician insights can be externalised, combined within Electronic Patient Records (EPRs), analysed by AI, and reintegrated into practice under clinician oversight. Findings demonstrate that effective knowledge-sharing is central to overcoming current limitations in the integration of AI in mental health.

title: PE Teacher and Classmate Support in Level of Physical Activity: The Role of Sex and BMI Status in Adolescents from Kosovo

detail.title: PE Teacher and Classmate Support in Level of Physical Activity: The Role of Sex and BMI Status in Adolescents from Kosovo

declarations.funderStatement: Yes

detail.abstract: The aim of this paper is to examine the role of physical education (PE) teacher and classmate support in relation to sex and BMI status in adolescents’ physical activity (PA) in Kosovo. A Classmate and Teacher Support Scale (with additional questions) was used on a cross-sectional sample of 608 girls and 620 boys aged 15–18, randomly selected from secondary schools of seven major municipalities in Kosovo. PA level was determined with a Physical Activity Screening Measure questionnaire. Descriptive statistics and a three-way ANOVA, along with Tukey’s HSD post hoc test, were employed. The findings showed the levels of teacher and classmate support to be important factors in stimulating adolescents’ PA. It was found that boys with normal weight, high support from teachers, and medium or high support from classmates were more physically active, compared with girls.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了体育教师和同学支持对科索沃青少年体育活动的影响，发现男孩在正常体重、高教师支持和中等或高同学支持的情况下比女孩更活跃。
AI.research_question: 体育教师和同学支持在科索沃青少年体育活动中的作用，以及与性别和BMI状态的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 了解在科索沃背景下，教师和同学支持如何影响青少年的体育活动水平，特别是考虑性别和BMI差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会支持理论，重点关注教师和同学支持对青少年体育行为的促进作用。
AI.method: 横断面研究设计，使用同学和教师支持量表及体育活动筛查问卷，样本为608名女孩和620名男孩（15-18岁），采用描述性统计和三因素方差分析。

AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了社会支持理论在青少年体育活动领域的应用，特别是在科索沃文化背景下的实证验证。

detail.abstract: As per IBEF, "Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) is identified as one of the crucial growth drivers of the Indian economy as it provides non-debt financial resources for the economic development of the country". Global corporations invest in India as it offers a unique investment environment which includes various investment incentives like tax concessions and cheap labour. Foreign Direct Investment in India has been on a rise in the recent years due to the unique investment environment, the development of technical capabilities, and economic growth. The study uses machine learning algorithms to predict Foreign Direct Investment to help investors and policy makers. It mainly uses GDP, Inflation Rate, Trade Openness as the factors to predict Foreign Direct Investment. Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) plays a crucial role in India's economic development, providing capital, technology transfer, and employment. Despite positive trends, predicting future FDI inflows is challenging due to global economic conditions and domestic policies.

detail.abstract: Ensuring high tax law compliance is one of the key objectives of every tax system. Yet, while tax law non-compliance is known to be significant amongst small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), the motivations underlying it remain surprisingly underexplored, particularly in the context of developing countries. Drawing on an extensive body of literature centred on personal income tax compliance in developed nations, this article introduces a novel theoretical framework for understanding the tax morale of corporate taxpayers, identifying five endogenous and six exogenous motivations for tax law (non)compliance. The proposed framework is informed by an innovative methodological approach, using a triangulation of primary data, including 42 interviews and 86 court cases, with a focus on value-added tax and corporate income tax. This article addresses for the first time the crucial question: why is compliance with tax law among small businesses so low, particularly in developing countries?

title: Reexamining the “Wheat Boom”: The Nature of Canadian Economic Growth, 1870–1913
affiliations: Texas Tech University - Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics, George Mason University and Mount Allison University

detail.title: Reexamining the “Wheat Boom”: The Nature of Canadian Economic Growth, 1870–1913
detail.abstract: Between 1896 and 1913, Canada experienced a significant increase in living standards, with real per capita incomes nearly doubling. Using the synthetic control method (SCM), we show that Canada’s post-1896 economic growth represented a positive, uniquely Canadian, and persistent structural break from the 1870 to 1895 trend. By 1913, real GDP per capita stood roughly 30–34% above its synthetic counterfactual, with total GDP similarly diverging. Re-estimating the SCM for exports and investment reveals only a transitory increase in exports, which largely fades before 1913, in contrast to a dramatic and sustained investment boom. An input–output-based linkage test (using a 1919 U.S. Leontief table as a proxy) indicates that sectors most closely tied to agriculture did not gain shares between 1896 and 1913. We therefore conclude that the episode was characterized by an investment boom largely unrelated to wheat, agriculture, or export industries more generally. Our findings, therefore, align with previous works suggesting that the moniker “Wheat Boom” is a misnomer, as this was not a case of export-led growth.

AI.tldr: 使用合成控制法研究发现，加拿大1896-1913年的经济增长是独特的结构性突破，主要由投资繁荣驱动，而非传统认为的小麦出口拉动。
AI.research_question: 加拿大1896-1913年的经济增长是否真正由小麦出口驱动？
AI.motivation: 重新评估加拿大历史上著名的"小麦繁荣"时期的经济增长驱动因素，挑战传统出口导向型增长的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合成控制法(SCM)、投入产出分析、结构断裂理论
AI.method: 使用合成控制法分析加拿大经济增长趋势，结合投入产出关联性检验（使用1919年美国Leontief表作为代理）
AI.findings: 1) 1896年后加拿大经济增长是独特的结构性突破；2) 出口增长只是暂时性的；3) 投资出现显著且持续的繁荣；4) 与农业相关的部门并未获得份额增长
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"小麦繁荣"作为出口导向型增长案例的传统观点，强调投资驱动的内生增长机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解资源型经济体的发展路径提供新视角，强调投资而非初级产品出口对长期增长的重要性

title: Extreme Temperatures, Health and Retirement
affiliations: Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER), University of California, Santa Barbara - College of Letters & Science - Department of Economics, Luxembourg Institute for Socio-Economic Research and Lund University

detail.title: Extreme Temperatures, Health and Retirement

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides novel evidence of the impact of temperature fluctuations on retirement behavior and underlying mechanisms, combining 30 years of rich longitudinal survey data with granular daily weather information. Exposure to cold and hot temperatures accelerates transitions into retirement, particularly among individuals unaccustomed to such conditions, and the effects are strongest among vulnerable populations facing greater health challenges and limited access to healthcare. Extreme temperatures deteriorate health through a higher incidence of cardiovascular diseases and strokes, reducing individuals' ability to work, while better access to healthcare mitigates the adverse effects of extreme temperatures on retirement behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合30年纵向调查数据与每日天气信息，发现极端温度会加速退休行为，特别是对不习惯此类条件的脆弱群体影响最大。极端温度通过增加心血管疾病和中风发病率损害健康，降低工作能力，而更好的医疗条件可以缓解这种影响。
AI.research_question: 温度波动如何影响退休行为？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解气候变化对劳动力市场决策的影响，特别是极端温度如何通过健康渠道影响退休时机选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康冲击理论和工作能力模型，探讨温度变化通过生理健康机制影响劳动力供给决策。
AI.method: 结合30年纵向调查数据和每日天气信息，分析温度暴露与退休行为的关系。
